answer: An agent’s signing key is generated inside an SGX or SEV enclave, and remote attestation links it to approved code measured by MRENCLAVE and to genuine hardware. With admission tied to hardware-backed attestation, copying a VM cannot forge a new trusted identity; creating additional identities requires acquiring attested physical silicon, not merely duplicating software. MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip, so the policy must also check platform credentials. This raises the cost of Sybil attacks without treating a crystal or meadow as evidence.
